note: Hooks only: an IForm's own form, on nyu.icims.com/forms, which src/adapters/icims/url.ts reads as no application (its address names no posting). Since core-x the frame is chained (src/adapters/chain.ts chainPageOf: role 'frame', family icims:nyu), keyed by the portal page around it, so a run reads its fields; icims-steps.browser.test.ts pins what it reads: the name box (filled from the profile) and the Signature box, a consent left to the person (its radios, labelled by bare text after each, and its date parts, by labels a person does not see, have no visible label). Their fields are not listed here: no element holds the radios' words, so no entry could name them as a person reads them.
